column1: # George Philip Commercial Chart, World (0724009.jpg), reference-only calibration.
# X controls are read from the printed lower graticule: Greenwich at x=314 and 15-degree intervals.
# Y controls use the map's Mercator graticule, with the Equator at y=3200 and the Arctic Circle
# agreeing with the printed line at approximately y=1130. X remains unwrapped so the raster seam
# can be converted into horizontal world copies by the renderer.
